scientific_integrity: Claim uses an infinite proof; finite exhaustive computations are additional checks, not proof by induction or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Cyclic odd orders n>=3 only. The known field Betti formula and general abelian-group rational translation characters are not novel claims. Homotopy argument gives integral wedge; no equivariant homotopy claim or even-order conclusion. Bibliographic uniqueness is not guaranteed.
title: Integral homotopy type of cyclic Latin-square clique complexes of odd order
